claims.text: Many reviewers say it removes makeup effectively, including stubborn or waterproof mascara, often in one application.
Several reviewers report skin or eye irritation, redness, or a burning sensation, especially those with sensitive skin.
Reviewers frequently praise the lavender scent as pleasant and not overpowering.
Some reviewers criticize the formula, noting it contains alcohol and is not true micellar water, or that it fails to remove eye makeup.
A few reviewers mention packaging issues, such as the stick being too long for the bottle.
